steps.body: {"persona": "sm", "prompt": "Write an implementation plan in markdown for this task: ${taskHint}\n\nThe plan_doc MUST reference every AC-<n> id from the story so coverage can be diffed automatically. Separately, produce a plan_diagram: a mermaid flowchart (starting with 'flowchart TD' or similar) showing the plan's architectural layers/edges.", "json_schema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"plan_doc": {"type": "string"}, "plan_diagram": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["plan_doc", "plan_diagram"]}, "rubric": "plan_coverage", "model": "haiku", "max_budget_usd": 0.5, "max_turns": 4, "task_id": "${taskId}"}
